user.title: Stuudium
user.description:
Each school has its own Stuudium address – the one in your browser's address bar when you are logged in, for example `myschool.ope.ee`. You can paste the whole address.

All children linked to your parent account are added automatically. For a child at another school, add Stuudium again with that school's address.

cookies.title: Log in with your browser
cookies.description:
Home Assistant can't type your password (Stuudium's login page has a captcha), so it borrows the login from your browser instead.

1. On a computer, open [{login_url}]({login_url}) and log in with **"Logi mind tulevikus automaatselt sisse"** switched on.
2. Press **F12** (Mac: **⌥⌘I**) → **Application** tab (Firefox: **Storage**) → **Cookies** → `https://{host}`.
3. In the **Name** column find **`_stdmss`**, double-click its **Value**, copy it and paste it below.

**Tip:** a whole `Cookie:` header or **Copy as cURL** from the Network tab works too – the right cookie is picked out automatically.

Don't press *Logi välja* in that browser afterwards, that would end this login too.

data_description.session_cookie: A long string of letters and numbers, e.g. a7714...c0. Only the value, not the name.

error.invalid_host: That doesn't look like a web address. Expected something like myschool.ope.ee.
error.invalid_cookie: Nothing usable was found in what was pasted. Copy the Value of the _stdmss cookie.
error.missing_session: The pasted text has cookies, but not _stdmss – that's the one Home Assistant needs.
error.invalid_auth: Stuudium did not accept these cookies (it showed the login page). Log in again in the browser and copy fresh values.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Stuudium site. Check the address.

abort.already_configured: This Stuudium account is already set up.
